records.claim: Metoclopramide is a medication that has been used to treat certain stomach conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux (when stomach contents flow backward into the esophagus), gastric stasis (when the stomach empties food more slowly than normal), nausea and vomiting, and to increase the amount of milk the body makes while breastfeeding. It has been sold under brand names such as Reglan®, Maxolon® or Metozolv ODT®.
